text: Explain and critically analyse the rules which apply to the recovery of damages for negligent
misstatement. [25]
Trespass to the person is necessary in order to protect the personal rights and security of the
individual.
Explain the legal principles associated with this tort and assess the validity of the above statement.
Explain and critically evaluate the use of vicarious liability in the law of tort. [25]
Section B
Charles has recently purchased a house opposite a tyre fitting business operated by Yasmin.
Charles has discovered that Yasmin has been granted permission by the local council to extend
the opening hours and the business will now be open 24 hours per day.
Over the next few weeks, the business becomes very busy. The noise from the business and its
customers has increased and is disturbing Charles, who works from home. He also believes that
the noise is interfering with his daughter’s ability to study for her A Level examinations. He has
spoken to Yasmin but she has responded by allowing her staff to play loud music while they work
which has increased the level of noise significantly.
Advise Charles and Yasmin as to their rights in this situation. [25]
Alice works in XYZ Supermarket. She is instructed to restock the shelves by her manager. In order
to reach the high shelves she has to stand on a chair as the ladder that she normally uses cannot
be found. The chair breaks and Alice falls, hitting her head on the concrete floor. She is taken to
hospital where Dr Smith, a junior doctor, diagnoses concussion. He prescribes medication for a
headache and sends her home.
A week later, Alice is feeling worse. She returns to the hospital and is immediately sent for an
X-ray. A senior doctor then discovers that Alice has a fractured skull.
Advise Alice as to the potential liability of XYZ Supermarket and Dr Smith. [25]
Devi has purchased a house and he has been informed by the seller that the roof is in poor
condition. Before moving in, Devi contacts a local builder, Pedro, and tells him that he is concerned
about the safety of the roof. He makes an appointment with Pedro to inspect the roof and provide
an estimate for repairs. Pedro arrives early and decides to go up to the roof, using his own ladder,
before Devi arrives. He begins to inspect the roof but as he walks on it a section gives way. Pedro
falls through the roof and suffers a serious back injury.
Advise Pedro as to his rights against Devi in this situation. [25]
